name: PhET
description: Founded in 2002 by Nobel Laureate Carl Wieman, the PhET Interactive Simulations project at the University of Colorado Boulder creates free interactive math and science simulations. PhET sims are based on extensive education research and engage students through an intuitive, game-like environment where students learn through exploration and discovery. Also, available at many languages.

name: Refactoring.Guru
description: Refactoring.Guru makes it easy for you to discover everything you need to know about refactoring, design patterns, SOLID principles, and other smart programming topics.

name: Distill
description: Distill was a journal for machine learning research that pioneered clear, interactive explanations of ML concepts, using live diagrams and visualizations instead of static prose to build genuine intuition.

name: DistroWatch
description: A comprehensive information resource dedicated to Linux and BSD distributions, tracking hundreds of open-source operating systems with release announcements, reviews, package news, and rankings for beginners and experienced users alike.

name: Mariusz Lewandowski
description: The official gallery of Mariusz Lewandowski (1960-2022), a Polish surrealist painter known for atmospheric, metaphysical landscapes, showcasing his original paintings and fine art prints.

name: Vincent Di Fate
description: Portfolio of Vincent Di Fate, a renowned science fiction illustrator, featuring imaginative artwork depicting space exploration, futuristic technology, and speculative science fiction concepts.

name: Ryan T. Hancock
description: Portfolio of Ryan T. Hancock, a sci-fi and fantasy freelance artist, showcasing album covers, book covers, fan art, and original paintings available as prints.

name: Smarthistory
description: A free, nonprofit multimedia resource for the history of art, offering essays, videos, and conversations that make art history accessible to everyone.

name: Sabaton
description: Official website of Sabaton, a Swedish heavy metal band known for historical and war-themed songs, featuring their music, tour dates, and merchandise.

name: Red Blob Games
description: Amit Patel's site of interactive explanations for game development topics like pathfinding, hex grids, and procedural generation, using live, tweakable diagrams instead of static text.

name: Ciechanowski
description: Bartosz Ciechanowski's blog of deeply interactive articles explaining how everyday physical and mechanical things work (gears, lenses, GPS, the Sun, and more) through custom animations and simulations.

name: FlowingData
description: Nathan Yau's blog covering data visualization, statistics, and design, with tutorials and commentary on how to turn data into clear, meaningful graphics.

name: The Coding Train
description: Daniel Shiffman's home for creative coding tutorials, covering generative art, simulations, and algorithms in JavaScript and p5.js, with a friendly and enthusiastic teaching style.

name: Shadertoy
description: A community platform for creating, sharing, and exploring GPU shaders written entirely in fragment shader code, ranging from abstract art to photorealistic scenes rendered in real time.

name: Zoomquilt
description: A collaborative art project made of an endlessly zooming, seamlessly looping painting, stitched together from illustrations by many different artists.

name: Windy
description: An interactive weather visualization map showing wind, rain, temperature, and other atmospheric data overlaid on the globe, with animated flow and forecast controls.
